text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... it's finally here. The Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)... Who are you rooting for?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be Eishin Flash! Her Derby was 
great, and a Derby Umamusume winning the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) would be so hype!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I wonder if Special Week will 
win. I really, really hope she wins...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
No way, you've gotta watch out for Grass 
Wonder! If she's at 100%, she's definitely 
taking the win!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy, come quick~! Please~!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Jordan's Tenno Sho (Autumn) is starting 
soon, huh... Man...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Come on... You can do it, Jordan...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Are you nervous too, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I want her to win. Jordan's 
been trying so hard..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I will win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Jordan will win. ...Definitely.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...City.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, let's believe. In the power 
of our friends.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Show me what you've got. Show me your 
running.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you know... About how I've 
been this past year.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, we were so ridiculously 
silly. We swam tons of pool laps, and went 
full-on Bakushin with Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the moment Gold Ship is your 
rival, you're already doomed. Competing 
over who's the bigger idiot, of all 
things...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still. Thanks to that, I was able to 
run pretty long distances, too. Like the 
Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I think I learned that wanting to 
win really, really matters. Now, I'm not 
scared of whoever I'm up against.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So keep dreamin' with me until the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna put on an incredible run that 
won't lose to any Umamusume in history."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
She's gonna run so crazy fast, she'll 
rewrite both trends and history.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me go do the most awesome, 
stupid thing ever. And make sure you think 
I look cool doing it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, which Umamusume will carve her 
new hoofprints into this storied history?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The strongest Umamusume, blessed with both 
popularity and skill, have all lined up in 
the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Tosen Jordan! I saw it, your 
press conference the other day!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator G
text_block_list.text:
She's popular, sure~... but what about her 
actual ability~? I mean, the other 
contenders are just way better...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(You guys can think whatever you want. 
Just make sure you keep your eyes glued to 
the race.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Me—standing victorious.
